messages:
sam: Quick sync 1: planning a coordinated rollforward tonight 22:00 UTC. We need pin confirmations for API/runtime/console/router and a concise rollback play.

sam: Proposed pins: api@3.5.0, runtime@3.0.0-rc, console@0.6.0, router@1.8.2. Plan is staggered waves with health checks between each service.

eva: noted. runtime@3.0.0-rc includes the new batching kernel. We should enable batch_size_cap=64 in canary only.

toni: console change includes the header propagation tweak 1. Confirming schema compatibility with router headers. If header mismatch, console should respond 400, not break routing.

sam: Rollback triggers I propose: sustained 5xx >1.5% for 4m OR p90 latency uplift >250ms for 4m OR tail token error surges in API.

oncall: add error-classification: if >20% of 5xx are auth failures, escalate to product immediately. Also add immediate abort on instance OOM/eviction.

infra: set autoscale buffer to +25%, pre-warm 2 extra nodes in runtime pool. I'll also pin router to drain connections gracefully with drain_timeout=120s.

deploybot: Ack. I will run a three-wave orchestrated job and attach abort hooks. Will post job id once scheduled.

eva: small ask 1: during canary, keep feature flags off for the new console UX. We can flip after full roll.

sam: agreed. product, do you want a short release note snippet in the thread?

product: Yes, posting the blurb: "Console header propagation update: improves context forwarding for embedded tools. Expected impact: lower debug log noise; no user-visible changes. Rollback safe to previous header format."

deploybot: Preparing command template: 
```
/deploy orchestrate --waves 3 --wave-config "[\"api:5%,runtime:5%\",\"api:25%,runtime:25%,router:25%\",\"100%\"]" --pins "api@3.5.0 runtime@3.0.0-rc console@0.6.0 router@1.8.2" --canary-flags "runtime.batch_size_cap=64" --abort "5xx>1.5%:4m,p90>250:4m,oom:0m,auth_5xx>20%:2m" --drain router:120s
```

sam: Good. Make sure the abort hook steps back runtime to 2.9.x and router to 1.7.9, and that api pins to 3.4.x fallback.

oncall: Confirmed. Abort will execute automated rollback + alert the oncall channel. Manual abort path: `/deploy abort <job-id> --reason \"manual safety\"`.

toni: I'll run a quick header-pass test on staging now and post results.

eva: preflight note: kernel telemetry landed good in staging & perf noise < 5%.

deploybot: Job scheduled: id=job-17120099, start=1712006400 (22:00 UTC), waves=[5,25,100], owner=@sam. Will stream to #eng-releases/deploy-logs.

infra: alarms and dashboards updated. I added a short velocity metric to detect request pacing anomalies.

product: added release note to the release-draft doc and linked it here: https://go/release-drafts/1712001234

sam: Final thumbs? We want to keep chatter minimal during window unless abort.

eva: +1

toni: +1 (staging pass ok)

oncall: +1, monitoring ready

infra: +1, infra green

sam: Thanks team 1. I'll post a 15-minute-before checklist and attach the runbook. Deploybot: start on schedule and post canary start update in this thread.

deploybot: Preflight ok. Will post canary start and step updates here. Logs will include short hashes for quick rollbacks.
